paper_title: FactBench A Dynamic Benchmark for In-the-Wild Language Model Factuality   Evaluation

model_annotation: This figure presents two pie charts illustrating the distribution of answer refusal categories for language models, labeled "Llama3.1-70B-Instruct" and "Llama3.1-405B-Instruct," each displayed as four quadrants. The "Llama3.1-70B-Instruct" pie chart is divided into four categories: “Safety” (red, 16.7%), "Ethical Advice" (yellow, 14.0%), “Clarification” (light green, 12.0%), “Lack of Knowledge” (blue, 22.1%), “Misinformation” (pink, 38.4%), and “Lack of Knowledge” (dark red, 83.3%), totaling 100%. Each slice is labeled with both a category name and a percentage. The chart includes a legend identifying the category names.  The “Llama3.1-405B-Instruct” pie chart also has four quadrants, showing “Clarification” (light green, 25.0%), “Lack of Knowledge” (red, 75.0%), “Lack of Knowledge” (orange, 50.0%), and “Misinformation” (purple, 2.0%) which is also labelled with percentages. The order of the segments in both charts appears to be visual and not indicating a particular ranking, though each pie chart has different segment sizes.
